(defconst *fn2-cns-source-core-faces*
 '((fn2-cns-source-capture-core . fn2-cns-source-capture-children)
   (fn2-cns-source-raw-step-core . fn2-cns-source-raw-step-children)
   (fn2-cns-source-issue-core . fn2-cns-source-issue-children)
   (fn2-cns-source-next-core . fn2-cns-source-next-children)
   (fn2-cns-source-release-core . fn2-cns-source-release-step)
   (fn2-cns-source-manifest-check-core . fn2-cns-source-manifest-check)
   (fn2-cns-source-manifest-entry-core . fn2-cns-source-manifest-entry)
   (fn2-cns-source-manifest-claim-core . fn2-cns-source-manifest-claim-step)
   (fn2-cns-source-manifest-data-core . fn2-cns-source-manifest-data-check)))
(defun fn2-cns-source-face-events (pairs world)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom pairs) nil
  (append (fn2-arms-op-face-events (caar pairs) (cdar pairs) world)
          (fn2-cns-source-face-events (cdr pairs) world))))
(defmacro fn2-cns-source-core-events ()
 '(progn
   (make-event (value (cons 'progn
                     (fn2-cns-source-face-events *fn2-cns-source-core-faces* (w state)))))
   ; Shape/WFP does not establish equal dimensions across distinct children.
   ; This bounded geometry check is retained by capture, not a core scan.
   (defun fn2-cns-source-contextp (cns cgen ctl ctlgen request fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (and (eq (fn2-cns-snapshot-read-code cns fn2-core) :ok)
         (equal (fn2-machine-generation cns fn2-core) cgen)
         (equal (fn2-cns-row-ctl cns fn2-core) ctl)
         (equal (fn2-cns-row-ctl-gen cns fn2-core) ctlgen)
         (equal (fn2-cns-row-request cns fn2-core) request)
         (let ((n (stobj-let ((fn2-cns (fn2-cns-table fn2-core))) (n) (fn2-cns-rows fn2-cns) n))
               (sn (stobj-let ((fn2-cns-sources (fn2-core-cns-sources fn2-core))) (n) (fn2-cns-sources-rows fn2-cns-sources) n))
               (f (stobj-let ((fn2-fc (fn2-core-fc fn2-core))) (n) (fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc) n))
               (b (stobj-let ((fn2-b3 (fn2-core-b3 fn2-core))) (n) (fn2-b3-rows fn2-b3) n))
               (c (stobj-let ((fn2-ctl (fn2-ctl-table fn2-core))) (n) (fn2-ctl-rows fn2-ctl) n))
               (fr (stobj-let ((fn2-fields (fn2-core-fields fn2-core))) (n) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields) n)))
          (and (equal n sn) (equal f b)
               (fn2-b-cns-source-geometry-p n c f)
               (<= (* 128 (+ 1 (fn2-b-cns-source-row (fn2-machine-slot cns fn2-core) n f))) fr)))))
   (defun fn2-cns-source-boundp (cns cgen ctl ctlgen request fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (and (fn2-cns-source-contextp cns cgen ctl ctlgen request fn2-core)
     (let ((s (fn2-machine-slot cns fn2-core)))
      (stobj-let ((fn2-cns-sources (fn2-core-cns-sources fn2-core)))
       (yes) (fn2-cns-source-ownerp s cns cgen ctl ctlgen request fn2-cns-sources) yes))))
   (defun fn2-cns-stream-source-capture (cns cgen x slot gen fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (let ((ctl (fn2-cns-row-ctl cns fn2-core))
          (cg (fn2-cns-row-ctl-gen cns fn2-core))
          (r (fn2-cns-row-request cns fn2-core)))
     (if (not (and (fn2-cns-source-contextp cns cgen ctl cg r fn2-core)
                   (equal (fn2-cns-row-lease cns fn2-core) *fn2-cns-lease-held*)
                   (equal (fn2-cns-row-lslot cns fn2-core) slot)
                   (equal (fn2-cns-row-lgen cns fn2-core) gen)
                   (equal (fn2-cns-row-xrow cns fn2-core) x)))
      (mv :bad 0 fn2-core)
      (fn2-cns-source-capture-core (fn2-machine-slot cns fn2-core)
        cns cgen ctl cg r x slot gen *fn2-cns-kind* fn2-core))))
   (fn2-core-preserves fn2-cns-stream-source-capture
    (cns cgen x slot gen fn2-core) :position 2 :rows nil)
   (defun fn2-cns-stream-source-next (cns cgen ctl ctlgen request slot gen off maximum fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (if (not (and (fn2-cns-source-boundp cns cgen ctl ctlgen request fn2-core)
                  (eq (fn2-ctl-stream-reply-status ctl ctlgen request cns cgen fn2-core) :active)
                  (equal (fn2-ctl-row-rx-slot ctl fn2-core) slot)
                  (equal (fn2-ctl-row-rx-gen ctl fn2-core) gen)))
     (mv :bad 0 nil fn2-core)
     (fn2-cns-source-next-core (fn2-machine-slot cns fn2-core) cns cgen ctl ctlgen request
                              slot gen off maximum *fn2-ctl-kind* fn2-core)))
   (fn2-core-preserves fn2-cns-stream-source-next
    (cns cgen ctl ctlgen request slot gen off maximum fn2-core) :position 3 :rows nil)
   (defun fn2-cns-source-preheader-quiet-p (cns ctl fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (let ((slot (fn2-ctl-row-rx-slot ctl fn2-core))
          (gen (fn2-ctl-row-rx-gen ctl fn2-core)))
     (and (equal (fn2-cns-row-stream cns fn2-core) 0)
          (equal (fn2-ctl-row-phase ctl fn2-core) *fn2-ctl-state-waiting*)
          (equal (fn2-ctl-row-ophase ctl fn2-core) *fn2-ctl-output-none*)
          (equal (fn2-ctl-row-pending ctl fn2-core) 0)
          (equal (fn2-ctl-row-borrows ctl fn2-core) 0)
          (eq (fn2-machine-pool-borrows-read-code slot fn2-core) :ok)
          (equal (fn2-machine-pool-borrows slot fn2-core) 0)
          (not (fn2-core-query-heldp slot gen fn2-core)))))
   ; Acknowledgement precedes the transport dropping its tuple. The actor
   ; consumes HANDOFF only after its own declared lease release succeeds.
   (defun fn2-cns-stream-source-finish (cns cgen ctl ctlgen request fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (if (not (fn2-cns-source-boundp cns cgen ctl ctlgen request fn2-core))
     (mv :stale fn2-core)
     (let* ((s (fn2-machine-slot cns fn2-core))
            (phase (stobj-let ((fn2-cns-sources (fn2-core-cns-sources fn2-core)))
                    (p) (fn2-cns-sources-phase s fn2-cns-sources) p)))
      (if (equal phase *fn2-cns-source-phase-handoff*) (mv :ok fn2-core)
       (let ((status (fn2-ctl-stream-reply-status ctl ctlgen request cns cgen fn2-core)))
        (if (not (or (member-eq status '(:handback :cancelled))
                     (and (eq status :active)
                          (equal phase *fn2-cns-source-phase-released*)
                          (fn2-cns-source-preheader-quiet-p cns ctl fn2-core))))
         (mv :wait fn2-core)
         (stobj-let ((fn2-cns-sources (fn2-core-cns-sources fn2-core)))
          (code fn2-cns-sources)
          (cond
           ((or (not (equal (fn2-cns-sources-pending s fn2-cns-sources) 0))
                (not (equal (fn2-cns-sources-uncertain s fn2-cns-sources) 0)))
            (mv :wait fn2-cns-sources))
           ((equal phase *fn2-cns-source-phase-released*)
            (let ((fn2-cns-sources (fn2-cns-sources-set-phase s *fn2-cns-source-phase-handoff* fn2-cns-sources)))
             (mv :ok fn2-cns-sources)))
           (t
            (let ((fn2-cns-sources (fn2-cns-sources-set-phase s *fn2-cns-source-phase-releasing* fn2-cns-sources)))
             (mv :wait fn2-cns-sources))))
          (mv code fn2-core))))))))
   (fn2-core-preserves fn2-cns-stream-source-finish
    (cns cgen ctl ctlgen request fn2-core) :position 1 :rows nil)
   (defun fn2-cns-stream-source-abort (cns cgen ctl ctlgen request fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (if (not (fn2-cns-source-boundp cns cgen ctl ctlgen request fn2-core)) fn2-core
     (let* ((s (fn2-machine-slot cns fn2-core))
            (fn2-core
             (stobj-let ((fn2-cns-sources (fn2-core-cns-sources fn2-core)))
              (fn2-cns-sources)
              (fn2-cns-sources-set-phase s *fn2-cns-source-phase-bad* fn2-cns-sources)
              fn2-core)))
      (if (and (eq (fn2-ctl-stream-reply-status ctl ctlgen request cns cgen fn2-core) :active)
               (equal (fn2-ctl-row-phase ctl fn2-core) *fn2-ctl-state-stream-reply*))
       (let* ((fn2-core (fn2-machine-write-phase ctl *fn2-ctl-state-closing* fn2-core))
              (fn2-core (fn2-core-scheduler-wake ctl fn2-core)))
        (if (fn2-core-stopped-p fn2-core) fn2-core
         (fn2-core-record-enqueue ctl fn2-core)))
       fn2-core))))
   (fn2-core-preserves fn2-cns-stream-source-abort (cns cgen ctl ctlgen request fn2-core) :rows nil)
   (defun fn2-cns-stream-source-clear (cns cgen ctl ctlgen request fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (if (not (and (fn2-cns-source-boundp cns cgen ctl ctlgen request fn2-core)
                  (equal (fn2-cns-row-lease cns fn2-core) *fn2-cns-lease-none*)))
     (mv :stale fn2-core)
     (let ((s (fn2-machine-slot cns fn2-core)))
      (stobj-let ((fn2-cns-sources (fn2-core-cns-sources fn2-core)))
       (code fn2-cns-sources)
       (if (equal (fn2-cns-sources-phase s fn2-cns-sources) *fn2-cns-source-phase-handoff*)
        (let ((fn2-cns-sources (fn2-cns-sources-set-phase s *fn2-cns-source-phase-free* fn2-cns-sources)))
         (mv :ok fn2-cns-sources))
        (mv :stale fn2-cns-sources))
       (mv code fn2-core)))))
   (fn2-core-preserves fn2-cns-stream-source-clear (cns cgen ctl ctlgen request fn2-core) :position 1 :rows nil)
   (defun fn2-cns-stream-source-issue (cns cgen ctl ctlgen request principal fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (if (not (and (fn2-cns-source-boundp cns cgen ctl ctlgen request fn2-core)
                  (eq (fn2-ctl-stream-reply-status ctl ctlgen request cns cgen fn2-core) :active)
                  (equal principal (fn2-cns-row-principal-slot cns fn2-core))))
     (mv :bad 0 0 fn2-core)
     (fn2-cns-source-issue-core (fn2-machine-slot cns fn2-core) cns cgen ctl ctlgen request
                              *fn2-cns-kind* principal fn2-core)))
   (fn2-core-preserves fn2-cns-stream-source-issue
    (cns cgen ctl ctlgen request principal fn2-core) :position 3 :rows nil)
   (defun fn2-cns-stream-source-step (cns cgen ctl ctlgen request started fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (b* (((unless (fn2-cns-source-boundp cns cgen ctl ctlgen request fn2-core)) (mv :stale fn2-core))
         (s (fn2-machine-slot cns fn2-core))
         ((mv phase stage pending uncertain retained)
          (stobj-let ((fn2-cns-sources (fn2-core-cns-sources fn2-core)))
           (p m n u r)
           (mv (fn2-cns-sources-phase s fn2-cns-sources)
               (fn2-cns-sources-manifest-stage s fn2-cns-sources)
               (fn2-cns-sources-pending s fn2-cns-sources)
               (fn2-cns-sources-uncertain s fn2-cns-sources)
               (fn2-cns-sources-retention-phase s fn2-cns-sources))
           (mv p m n u r)))
         ((when (equal uncertain 1)) (mv :uncertain fn2-core))
         ; HANDOFF no longer requires a live CTL tuple: CTL has acknowledged
         ; completion and may already have advanced to its next request.
         ((when (equal phase *fn2-cns-source-phase-handoff*)) (mv :handoff fn2-core))
         (transport (fn2-ctl-stream-reply-status ctl ctlgen request cns cgen fn2-core))
         ((when (eq transport :aborting)) (mv :wait fn2-core))
         ((when (eq transport :stale)) (mv :stale fn2-core))
         ((when (equal pending 1)) (mv :wait fn2-core))
         ((when (or (equal phase *fn2-cns-source-phase-releasing*)
                    (equal phase *fn2-cns-source-phase-released*)
                    (eq transport :cancelled) (eq transport :handback)
                    (and (equal phase *fn2-cns-source-phase-bad*) (not started))))
          (b* (((when (equal phase *fn2-cns-source-phase-released*)) (mv :released fn2-core))
               (fn2-core
                (stobj-let ((fn2-cns-sources (fn2-core-cns-sources fn2-core)))
                 (fn2-cns-sources)
                 (fn2-cns-sources-set-phase s *fn2-cns-source-phase-releasing* fn2-cns-sources)
                 fn2-core))
               ((mv code fn2-core) (fn2-cns-source-release-core 1 s cns cgen ctl ctlgen request fn2-core)))
           (mv (case code (:released :released) (:more :more) (:source :wait) (otherwise :bad)) fn2-core)))
         ((when (equal phase *fn2-cns-source-phase-bad*)) (mv :bad fn2-core))
         ((when (and (not started) (equal retained *fn2-cns-source-retention-ready*))) (mv :covered fn2-core))
         (connections (stobj-let ((fn2-ctl (fn2-ctl-table fn2-core))) (n) (fn2-ctl-rows fn2-ctl) n))
         (rows (stobj-let ((fn2-b3 (fn2-core-b3 fn2-core))) (n) (fn2-b3-rows fn2-b3) n))
         (n (stobj-let ((fn2-cns-sources (fn2-core-cns-sources fn2-core))) (n) (fn2-cns-sources-rows fn2-cns-sources) n))
         (base (* 128 (fn2-b-cns-source-row s n rows))))
     (if (equal phase *fn2-cns-source-phase-manifest*)
      (cond
       ((member-equal stage (list *fn2-cns-source-manifest-stage-read* *fn2-cns-source-manifest-stage-data-read*))
        (mv :need-read fn2-core))
       ((equal stage *fn2-cns-source-manifest-stage-check*)
        (fn2-cns-source-manifest-check-core s cns cgen ctl ctlgen request *fn2-cns-kind* base fn2-core))
       ((equal stage *fn2-cns-source-manifest-stage-entry*)
        (fn2-cns-source-manifest-entry-core s cns cgen ctl ctlgen request *fn2-cns-kind* base fn2-core))
       ((equal stage *fn2-cns-source-manifest-stage-claim*)
        (fn2-cns-source-manifest-claim-core s cns cgen ctl ctlgen request fn2-core))
       ((equal stage *fn2-cns-source-manifest-stage-data-check*)
        (fn2-cns-source-manifest-data-core s cns cgen ctl ctlgen request *fn2-cns-kind* fn2-core))
       (t (mv :wait fn2-core)))
      (fn2-cns-source-raw-step-core s cns cgen ctl ctlgen request *fn2-cns-kind* connections 4096 fn2-core))))
   (fn2-core-preserves fn2-cns-stream-source-step
    (cns cgen ctl ctlgen request started fn2-core) :position 1 :rows nil)
 ))

; verified and hashed bytes; it never issues or verifies a storage unit.

(defun fn2-cns-source-issue-children (s cns cnsgen ctl ctlgen request kind principal
 fn2-cns-sources fn2-cns-source-operations fn2-extents fn2-alloc-edges fn2-pool fn2-ops fn2-control fn2-checkpoints)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-cns-sources fn2-cns-source-operations fn2-extents fn2-alloc-edges fn2-pool fn2-ops fn2-control fn2-checkpoints)
 :guard (and (fn2-cns-sources-wfp fn2-cns-sources) (fn2-cns-source-operations-wfp fn2-cns-source-operations)
 (fn2-checkpoints-wfp fn2-checkpoints) (fn2-extents-wfp fn2-extents) (fn2-alloc-edges-wfp fn2-alloc-edges) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool) (fn2-ops-wfp fn2-ops) (fn2-control-wfp fn2-control))))
 (b* (((unless (and (fn2-cns-source-ownerp s cns cnsgen ctl ctlgen request fn2-cns-sources)
                    (equal kind (fn2-cns-sources-owner-kind s fn2-cns-sources))
                    (equal (fn2-cns-sources-pending s fn2-cns-sources) 0) (equal (fn2-cns-sources-borrow-count s fn2-cns-sources) 0)
                    (equal (fn2-cns-source-operations-rows fn2-cns-source-operations) (fn2-ops-rows fn2-ops))))
       (mv :bad 0 0 fn2-cns-sources fn2-cns-source-operations fn2-pool fn2-ops fn2-control fn2-extents fn2-alloc-edges))
      (phase (fn2-cns-sources-phase s fn2-cns-sources))
      (stage (fn2-cns-sources-manifest-stage s fn2-cns-sources))
      (raw (equal phase *fn2-cns-source-phase-raw-read*))
      (manifest (and (equal phase *fn2-cns-source-phase-manifest*) (equal stage *fn2-cns-source-manifest-stage-read*)))
      (data (and (equal phase *fn2-cns-source-phase-manifest*) (equal stage *fn2-cns-source-manifest-stage-data-read*)))
      (at (if data *fn2-cns-source-data-offset* *fn2-cns-source-prefix*))
      (slot (fn2-cns-sources-lslot s fn2-cns-sources)) (gen (fn2-cns-sources-lgen s fn2-cns-sources))
      (len (if manifest *fn2-commit-unit-bytes*
             (if raw (min *fn2-commit-unit-bytes* (nfix (- (fn2-cns-sources-total s fn2-cns-sources) (fn2-cns-sources-offset s fn2-cns-sources))))
               (fn2-cns-sources-unit-length s fn2-cns-sources))))
      (unit (if manifest (+ (fn2-cns-sources-root-unit s fn2-cns-sources) (fn2-cns-sources-manifest-index s fn2-cns-sources))
             (if raw (+ (fn2-cns-sources-root-unit s fn2-cns-sources) (fn2-cns-sources-unit-index s fn2-cns-sources)) (fn2-cns-sources-unit s fn2-cns-sources))))
      (epoch (if data (fn2-cns-sources-epoch s fn2-cns-sources) (fn2-cns-sources-root-epoch s fn2-cns-sources)))
      (allocation (if data (fn2-cns-sources-allocation s fn2-cns-sources) (fn2-cns-sources-root-allocation s fn2-cns-sources)))
      (o (fn2-ops-free-head fn2-ops))
      ((unless (and (or raw manifest data)
                    (equal (fn2-cns-sources-uncertain s fn2-cns-sources) 0)
                    (fn2-cns-source-heldp s cns cnsgen ctl ctlgen request unit epoch allocation fn2-cns-sources fn2-checkpoints fn2-extents fn2-alloc-edges fn2-ops)
                    (if manifest t (equal (fn2-cns-sources-retention-phase s fn2-cns-sources) *fn2-cns-source-retention-ready*))
                    (posp len) (<= len *fn2-commit-unit-bytes*)
                    (if data (fn2-cns-source-data-position-p s fn2-cns-sources) t)
                    (if raw (and (equal (fn2-cns-sources-location-kind s fn2-cns-sources) 0)
                                 (equal (fn2-cns-sources-offset s fn2-cns-sources) (* *fn2-commit-unit-bytes* (fn2-cns-sources-unit-index s fn2-cns-sources)))
                                 (equal (fn2-cns-sources-offset s fn2-cns-sources) (fn2-cns-sources-hash-offset s fn2-cns-sources))) t)
                    (eq (fn2-pool-workspace-code slot gen kind cns cnsgen fn2-pool) :ok)
                    (<= at (fn2-pool-fill slot fn2-pool))
                    (fn2-op-slotp o fn2-ops) (< o (fn2-cns-source-operations-rows fn2-cns-source-operations))
                    (equal (fn2-cns-source-operations-live o fn2-cns-source-operations) 0)))
       (mv :wait 0 0 fn2-cns-sources fn2-cns-source-operations fn2-pool fn2-ops fn2-control fn2-extents fn2-alloc-edges))
      ((mv trim fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-truncate slot gen at kind cns cnsgen fn2-pool))
      ((mv code op opgen fn2-pool fn2-ops fn2-control fn2-extents fn2-alloc-edges)
       (if (eq trim :ok) (fn2-block-read-children unit epoch allocation 0 len slot gen kind cns cnsgen principal fn2-extents fn2-alloc-edges fn2-pool fn2-ops fn2-control)
        (mv :bounds 0 0 fn2-pool fn2-ops fn2-control fn2-extents fn2-alloc-edges)))
      ((unless (eq code :ok))
       (let ((fn2-cns-sources (if (equal (fn2-control-stop fn2-control) 1)
              (fn2-cns-sources-put s (phase *fn2-cns-source-phase-bad*) (uncertain 1)) fn2-cns-sources)))
        (mv (if (and (eq code :exhausted) (equal (fn2-control-stop fn2-control) 0)) :wait :bad) op opgen fn2-cns-sources fn2-cns-source-operations fn2-pool fn2-ops fn2-control fn2-extents fn2-alloc-edges)))
      (fn2-cns-source-operations (fn2-cns-source-operations-put op (live 1) (generation opgen) (source-row s)))
      (fn2-cns-sources (fn2-cns-sources-put s (pending 1) (op-slot op) (op-gen opgen) (unit-length len) (unit-copied 0) (unit-hashed 0)
       (phase (if raw *fn2-cns-source-phase-raw-wait* phase))
       (manifest-stage (cond (manifest *fn2-cns-source-manifest-stage-wait*) (data *fn2-cns-source-manifest-stage-data-wait*) (t stage))))))
  (mv :ok op opgen fn2-cns-sources fn2-cns-source-operations fn2-pool fn2-ops fn2-control fn2-extents fn2-alloc-edges)))

(defun fn2-cns-source-harvest (op opgen cell event outcome reason count aux0 aux1 fn2-cns-sources fn2-cns-source-operations)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-cns-sources fn2-cns-source-operations)
 :guard (and (fn2-cns-sources-wfp fn2-cns-sources) (fn2-cns-source-operations-wfp fn2-cns-source-operations))) (ignore aux0 aux1))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp op) (< op (fn2-cns-source-operations-rows fn2-cns-source-operations))

;; One callback performs one phase, never both a manifest-unit check and a
;; data-unit check. Charge the shared two-pass data verifier plus both expected
;; digests, or the unit/header/original-identity check, within four units.
(defconst *fn2-cns-source-unit-work-bytes* (* 4 *fn2-commit-unit-bytes*))
(assert-event (<= (+ (* 2 *fn2-commit-unit-bytes*) 64) *fn2-cns-source-unit-work-bytes*))
(assert-event (<= (+ *fn2-commit-unit-bytes* (* 2 *fn2-am-header-max*) 96) *fn2-cns-source-unit-work-bytes*))
(assert-event (<= (* 2 *fn2-am-entry-max*) *fn2-cns-source-unit-work-bytes*))

      (slot (fn2-cns-sources-lslot s fn2-cns-sources))

      ((unless (and (< index (fn2-cns-sources-manifest-count s fn2-cns-sources))
                    (<= (* 32 (+ 1 index)) (fn2-cns-sources-hashes s fn2-cns-sources))))
       (mv :bounds fn2-cns-sources fn2-fields fn2-b3 fn2-digests))
      ((mv code fn2-b3 fn2-digests)
       (fn2-block-read-commitment-children *fn2-commit-unit-bytes* *fn2-commit-unit-bytes*
        slot gen *fn2-cns-source-manifest-offset* slot gen (* 32 index)
        kind cns cnsgen fn2-b3 fn2-digests fn2-pool))
      ((unless (eq code :ok))
       (let ((fn2-cns-sources (fn2-cns-sources-set-phase s *fn2-cns-source-phase-bad* fn2-cns-sources)))

      ((mv code fn2-fields fn2-digests)
       (if (not (equal index 0)) (mv :ok fn2-fields fn2-digests)
        (b* (((mv code end fn2-fields)
              (fn2-am-get-header base (fn2-cns-sources-total s fn2-cns-sources) slot gen

             ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv :bad fn2-fields fn2-digests))

                    (equal (fn2-cns-sources-phase s fn2-cns-sources) *fn2-cns-source-phase-manifest*)
                    (equal (fn2-cns-sources-manifest-stage s fn2-cns-sources) *fn2-cns-source-manifest-stage-entry*)

        kind cns cnsgen fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      ((unless (and (eq code :ok) (< seen total) (equal lo seen)
                    (equal len (min *fn2-commit-unit-bytes* (- total seen)))
                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 next) (unsigned-byte-p 32 len)

                    (equal (fn2-cns-sources-manifest-stage s fn2-cns-sources) *fn2-cns-source-manifest-stage-claim*)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-cns-sources fn2-extents fn2-alloc-edges))

      (count (+ 1 (fn2-cns-sources-retain-entry-index s fn2-cns-sources)))
      ((unless (and (posp len) (<= (+ seen len) total) (unsigned-byte-p 32 count)
                    (<= count (fn2-am-blocks total))))

        (mv :bad fn2-cns-sources fn2-extents fn2-alloc-edges)))

       (fn2-cns-source-claim-identity s cns cnsgen ctl ctlgen request

      (replay (equal (fn2-cns-sources-retention-phase s fn2-cns-sources) 2))
      (end (+ seen len))

      (next-index (floor (fn2-cns-sources-manifest-position s fn2-cns-sources) *fn2-commit-unit-bytes*))

             (t
